title: Duel with Paz Vizsla
description: The Darksaber, originally made by Tarre Vizsla, the first Mandalorian to become a Jedi, is said to be the chosen weapon of the rightful ruler of Mandalore. It is cursed, though, and that anyone who rules Mandalore and did not win it in fair combat would bring about the ruination of the Mandalorian people. Many believe this is how Bo-Katan Kryze led the Mandalorians into the Night of a Thousand Tears. When Din Djarin arrives at the last vestiges of his former covert with the Darksaber, Paz Vizsla, a descendent of Tarre, challenges him for the fabled blade.
